AwkBeats Prep Station is a local desktop catalog for preparing beats. Powered by AwkBeats.

Version 1.0.1 ad-hoc signs the Mac app so Apple Silicon no longer reports it as damaged.

The installers are not notarized.

- macOS: if Gatekeeper still blocks the app, run `xattr -cr "/Applications/AwkBeats Prep Station.app"` or right-click the app and choose Open.
- Windows: if SmartScreen appears, choose More info, then Run anyway.
